## Purpose

Describe the authority, consistency, migration, or developer-experience problem this change solves.

## Declaration and manifest impact

- [ ] No declaration or manifest change
- [ ] Manifest change is deterministic and documented
- [ ] Backward compatibility and schema implications are documented

## Runtime and provider guarantees

- [ ] Concurrency behavior is explicit
- [ ] Failure behavior is explicit
- [ ] Observation behavior is explicit
- [ ] Provider-specific guarantees do not leak into the core contract

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Provider contract tests
- [ ] End-to-end tests where applicable
- [ ] Analyzer tests where applicable
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated
- [ ] `eng/build.ps1` or `eng/build.sh` passes
